purpose: Hash-pinned inventory of every input this repository reads. A pin is an integrity statement about the bytes on this machine, not an authentication of organizer provenance.
retrieval_route: GitHub Git Blobs API from the immutable public owner-maintained mirror commit buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE@dcbbb192e56b2b32c0a131eba791dc363305d4a3; exact blob and SHA-256 pins, plus the sibling-derived LiDAR cache pins, are in registry/bridge_sources.json. Fetch/assemble/verify with bash scripts/download_competition_data.sh.
why_not_direct: The DrivenData competition data page requires participant login. This sandbox cannot download the login-gated files directly through the shell, so the competition bytes are restored from the public owner-maintained mirror and hash-checked. A matching mirror hash is byte identity only; it is not direct organizer authentication, licensing advice, or permission to redistribute.

catalogue.role: the competition fault catalogue (USGS quaternary faults + INGENIOUS), rasterised on the 100 m grid; 60,988 positive cells; int8; nodata -1. THIS is the object the corrections lane measures.
catalogue.provenance: public owner-maintained mirror copy of the login-gated DrivenData data-tab file, at the immutable source commit recorded in registry/bridge_sources.json; byte hash verified, but not direct organizer authentication
catalogue.not_authenticated_by: no organizer signature; no DrivenData account in this sandbox

sample.role: the organizer's sample submission, used by the format gate as the CRS/shape/transform reference
sample.provenance: public owner-maintained mirror of the sample submission listed on the DrivenData data page, at the immutable source commit recorded in registry/bridge_sources.json; byte hash verified, but not direct organizer authentication

features.role: official 19-band GeoDAWN numerical feature stack, 100 m, EPSG:32611
features.rebuild: bash scripts/download_competition_data.sh fetches five pinned feature shards from the immutable owner mirror commit, verifies each shard's byte count and SHA-256, assembles data/training_features.tif, and verifies the assembled bytes.
features.provenance: public owner-maintained mirror of the competition data tab; all shard and assembled hashes are recorded in registry/bridge_sources.json; direct organizer authentication was not possible here
features.not_authenticated_by: the manifest is owner-maintained; the original download was not witnessed by this session

lidar_scarp.role: LiDAR calibration layer: int16, 7 bands, value/SCALE encodings (h_all m, strike_at deg, facing_at, cover fraction), built by GEMSDOE48 from 700 USGS 3DEP 1 m tiles (NV WestCentral EarthMRI 2020) resampled to 3 m and aggregated to the competition grid
lidar_scarp.provenance: sibling-derived 100 m summary from buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE48 at pinned commit 268ec599f51c517cc3485da077c24d83af5be81d; not an organizer file or a direct USGS 1 m DEM
lidar_scarp.caveat: A derived 3 m LiDAR analysis aggregated to a 100 m scarp summary. The original 1 m USGS rasters and the regional source tile list were not obtained in this review. It is used only as an optional calibration cache, not as the competition scoring target.
